description: This file contains unit tests for the BasketService's transfer basket functionality in the eShopOnWeb project. It tests scenarios like transferring anonymous basket to a user basket, merging items, deleting anonymous baskets, and creating new user baskets when necessary.

classes.name: Results
classes.description: A helper class to queue and return predefined results for asynchronous method calls in tests.

classes.name: TransferBasket
classes.description: The main test class containing unit tests for the basket transfer process.

methods.name: InvokesBasketRepositoryFirstOrDefaultAsyncOnceIfAnonymousBasketNotExists
methods.description: Tests that the basket repository's FirstOrDefaultAsync method is invoked once when the anonymous basket does not exist.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketItemsWhilePreservingExistingUserBasketItems
methods.description: Verifies that items from an anonymous basket are transferred to an existing user basket, maintaining the correct item counts and prices.

methods.name: RemovesAnonymousBasketAfterUpdatingUserBasket
methods.description: Ensures that the anonymous basket is deleted after its items are transferred to the user basket.

methods.name: CreatesNewUserBasketIfNotExists
methods.description: Checks that a new basket is created for a user if one does not already exist during transfer.
